name: Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64)
description: Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 runtime (64-bit), needed by most Windows apps and games.
notes: Microsoft's redistributable from aka.ms. The aka.ms link always serves the latest build, so the pinned sha256 goes stale when Microsoft publishes a new one: re-download, verify the signature and update the hash.
